summary: Iteration 2 testing — Tasks, Cancel-Order with stock-restock, and POS Delivery flow. Backend: 27/27 pytest passing (existing 18 + 9 new across TestTasks, TestCancelOrder, TestDeliveryCheckout). Frontend: Tasks page (create/toggle), POS delivery checkbox + address + charges + total update, and Orders cancel flow all verified live against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: make_invoice_no() uses ASC-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (second precision); under back-to-back checkouts within 1s pymongo raises DuplicateKeyError on orders.invoice_no unique index → 500. Reproducible by issuing two checkouts in the same second. Workaround in tests: 1.1s sleep. Suggested fix: append a short random/ms suffix or use ObjectId/uuid for invoice_no.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid^='task-delete-'] did not visibly remove the task in our run; possibly requires AlertDialog confirmation whose button has no canonical data-testid (text 'Delete'/'Confirm'/'Yes' not matched). Backend DELETE /api/tasks/{id} works. Verify confirm button has a data-testid like 'task-delete-confirm-btn'.

issues: Recharts still logs width(-1) height(-1) warnings (carry-over from iteration 1, non-blocking).

action_items: Make invoice_no collision-proof: append millisecond/uuid suffix in make_invoice_no() to avoid 500 on rapid back-to-back checkouts.
Add a data-testid (e.g., 'task-delete-confirm-btn') to the AlertDialog confirm button on Tasks delete to make it deterministically testable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1330 lines — splitting into routers (auth/products/orders/tasks/analytics) is increasingly worth it.

POST /api/orders/{oid}/cancel has no role gating — any authenticated user (incl. staff) can cancel any order, restocking inventory and reversing customer balance. Consider restricting to admin or limiting to orders the user created.
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} has no permission check — any logged-in user can update any task (including reassigning). Backend only gates DELETE. Consider restricting edits to creator/assignee/admin.
make_invoice_no() second-precision is racy (see minor backend issue above).

Tasks list scope='today' default: when user has many old pending tasks (overdue), the $or branch {due_date: {$lt: today}, status: 'pending'} may surface them even when scope is intended to be 'today only' — confirm this is desired (currently treated as 'today + overdue pending', which is reasonable).

rca of the issue: Invoice duplicate-key 500 RCA: make_invoice_no formats datetime with second precision (%Y%m%d%H%M%S). orders.invoice_no has a unique index. Two checkouts within the same UTC second collide → DuplicateKeyError → 500. Reproduced by two consecutive POST /api/pos/checkout calls in <1s. Mitigation in tests: sleep 1.1s between checkouts. Permanent fix: append milliseconds or 4-char random/uuid suffix, or switch to per-day counter.
